title: Exploring the Tumor Micro-Environment with 68Ga-FAPi-46 PET/CT in Breast Cancer
official: Exploring the Tumor Micro-Environment with 68Ga-FAPi-46 PET/CT in Breast Cancer. a Phase II Study to Evaluate the Comparison of 68Ga-FAPi-46 and 18F-FDG Uptake in Patients with Different Breast Cancer Subtypes
summary: This study is a prospective, non-interventional, open-label study to evaluate the glucose metabolism and the expression of the imaging agent 68 Gallium-Fibroblast Activation Protein Inhibitor-46 (68Ga-FAPi-46) with PET imaging, in woman affected by Breast Cancer (BC) and referred to diagnostic imaging work-up prior to primary therapy.
